{{Quote|The best advice I can give you is what my drill instructor once told me: 'Weapons are just specialized tools. Only a fool would let a tool do his thinking for him.'|Mark Linth|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Marck Linth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and member of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|5th Regiment]], commonly known as SpecForce Infiltrators. Linth held the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />
